title: A proper morphism has closed image
statement:
The image of a proper [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] morphism $f:X\to Y$
is closed in $Y$ (a proper morphism is universally closed, hence closed, and
its image is a closed subset carrying an induced $Y$-scheme structure).

mathlib_match.how: one-line specialization: for `f : X ⟶ Y` with `[IsProper f]`, the instance `UniversallyClosed f` is the parent projection of `class IsProper ... extends IsSeparated f, UniversallyClosed f, LocallyOfFiniteType f` (Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Morphisms/Proper.lean:42), so `f.isClosedMap.isClosed_range : IsClosed (Set.range f)` via `IsClosedMap.isClosed_range` (Mathlib/Topology/Maps/Basic.lean:567). The parenthetical 'induced Y-scheme structure' is the explanatory remark that a closed subset carries a closed-subscheme structure, not a further assertion.
